notParallel.text: This test runs alone while its siblings wait, because its first statement is not Parallel on its own *testing.T. Make that call its first statement, or, if it touches state no other test may share at the same time, say which in a `// Not parallel: <reason>` comment directly above it, so the next reader knows before changing it.

notParallelWithoutReason.text: This test says it is not parallel and gives no reason. Name what it shares after `Not parallel:`, such as the environment, the working directory or a package variable, because a marker with nothing after it tells the next reader nothing and excuses nothing.
